description:
## Stable MiXplorer support

- Adds `com.mixplorer` **6.71.15**, ARM64 build **26090422**.
- Retains `com.mixplorer.beta` **6.71.15-BETA**, ARM64 build **26090412**.
- Android 11+ only. Silver, universal APKs, other builds, and other architectures are not supported.

[Add the source to Morphe](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=ak800i/mixplorer-patches-for-morphe), or import `MiXplorer-Sharing-Fix-0.2.0.mpp` locally. See the [installation instructions and original APK checksums](https://github.com/ak800i/mixplorer-patches-for-morphe/blob/v0.2.0/README.md).

**Back up settings and app-private data before replacing an officially signed installation.** Android requires removing that edition before installing a re-signed APK. Keep your Morphe signing key for subsequent patched updates.

## Verification

All eight tests pass. Official Morphe recognizes both exact targets. Stable MiXplorer passed startup, native single-file and two-file receiver checks, and same-UID path checks on a Galaxy A71 running Android 13. Both shared payloads matched their source SHA-256 hashes.

Beta previously passed the same device checks with 0.1.0; patch application was rechecked with 0.2.0. **No live Telegram UI/network upload was tested.** The diagnostic receiver models Telegram's file-reading behavior.

Only the patch bundle and source are distributed, not modified APKs or signing keys.
